text.description_html:
Omnia 726/300, 15 Inch Refrigerator Door Pull

This contemporary, contoured appliance door pull is crafted from high grade solid stainless steel. It is available in either a brushed or polished finish. The 15 Inch Stainless Steel Appliance Pull is not just for refrigerators, it would look great on your oven or dishwasher too! It has a 14-15/16 inch overall length with a 11-3/4 inch center to center.

Specifications of the Modern Curvy Appliance Pull:

  • Overall Length: 14-15/16"
  • Center to Center Mount: 11-3/4"
  • Projection: 2-3/4"
  • Solid Stainless Steel

Available in US32D - Brushed Stainless Steel or US32 - Polished Stainless Steel finish.

Packaged with mounting screws for a refrigerator/appliance door panel.

Sold Individually
